stem: Which ending result or final point follows “But Alice knew he had done more than that.”?
options: Sometimes it is about working with what happens and finding beauty in the result.

He had cared about a student's worry after his workday should have been over.
Bikes can be taken on the boat before 10:00 a.m. and after 4:00 p.m.
